mobileHardware.cableObservation: On this test device, direct USB-C to Lightning repeatedly entered Recovery. USB-A to Lightning through a USB-C adapter successfully entered DFU. This is a troubleshooting observation, not a universal compatibility requirement.
mobileHardware.scopeNote: Acceptance applies only to iPhone 6 / iPhone7,2. Broader iPhone and iPad coverage remains pending.

iPadHardware.cableObservation: The current physical-Home timing profile succeeded. This observation does not establish that USB-A to Lightning is required; alternate cable advice remains troubleshooting guidance only.
iPadHardware.scopeNote: Real Normal and Recovery detection, guided same-ECID DFU, compatible iPadOS discovery, GUI download, IPSW validation, and Recovery-mode GUI Restore have passed. Live Restore progress, restart verification, and full end-to-end acceptance remain pending.

newerMacHardware.portObservation: On the tested Mac17,6, automatic DFU entry required the rightmost USB-C port on the left side. After transition, moving the cable to the other left-side USB-C port allowed the already-DFU target to enumerate immediately. This is a tested-hardware observation, not a universal M4/M5-era MacBook port mapping; consult Apple's model-specific DFU-port guidance.
newerMacHardware.scopeNote: Mac17,6 passed discovery, automatic Enter DFU, DFU rediscovery with the recorded port-change caveat, macOS Restore, structured progress, and verified restart to Normal.

multiDeviceHardware.scopeNote: Two simultaneously connected iPad12,1 Recovery targets completed the explicitly selected, ECID-targeted sequential Restore workflow.

mobileCachedFirmwareAssignment.scopeNote: A replacement physical iPad12,1 connected in Recovery received the exact validated managed-cache firmware assignment without invoking Use Latest Compatible Firmware, immediately became Ready to restore, and remained unselected until the user explicitly selected it. No automatic download or Restore occurred.

scopeNote: Mac14,2, Mac17,6, and iPhone7,2 are accepted end-to-end. iPad7,11 has passed Normal and Recovery detection, guided same-ECID DFU, firmware discovery, GUI download, validation, and Recovery-mode GUI Restore; live progress, restart verification, and full end-to-end acceptance remain pending. Two simultaneously connected iPad12,1 Recovery targets passed sequential Restore, and replacement-iPad exact cached firmware auto-assignment passed while preserving explicit operation selection. Broader Apple Silicon, Intel T2, iPhone, and iPad coverage remains pending.
